r4a-join-t7.title: Join arithmetic + T7 invariants
r4a-join-t7.imperative: Verify normalized weighted average (w_i=comp_i/Sigmacomp, corner_share=Sigmacomp NOT 1.0), T7-1..T7-4 assert equality to the simple case, and RECOMPUTE T7-5 by hand confirming it discriminates div-by-k and unnormalized bugs. Record pass/fail.
r4a-join-t7.finding: Code: w_i=comp_i/corner_share (sum=1), corner_share=fsum(comps) NOT 1.0, prior_mean=fsum(w*m)/resolved_weight=mu_res. HAND-RECOMPUTED T7-5: means[10,20,30] comp{.2,.3,.1} corner_share=0.6 -> weights(1/3,1/2,1/6) -> mean=10/3+10+5=55/3=18.3333. div-by-k=20, unnormalized-sum=11; test asserts !=approx(20) and !=approx(11) so BOTH bugs are discriminated (corner_share!=1 is what separates them). T7-1 asserts EQUALITY to mean(means)=21 (comparator documented). T7-2/T7-3/T7-4 checked: T7-3 single-class -> combined_scale==cell sigma 0.25 via closed form scale=0.25*sqrt(1+1/8), mean==12. All exact.

r4b-sigma.title: Sigma propagation + thin widening
r4b-sigma.imperative: Verify combined_scale quadrature with fat unresolved term, sigma_unres CAN EXCEED resolved sigma, and the thin-widening test proves the unresolved path FATTENS (not caps). Record pass/fail.
r4b-sigma.finding: combined_scale=sqrt(sum_res w^2 sigma^2 + (weight_on_thin*sigma_unres)^2); sigma_unres=max(cross-class mean spread, max_resolved_sigma) so it CAN EXCEED resolved sigma. HAND-CHECKED thin-widening test: all-resolved scale~0.064; flip highest-weight class sev1->unresolved gives spread=pstdev([10,30])=10 => sigma_unres=10 => combined_scale~5.0 >> 0.064. STRICTLY WIDER and the unresolved term (5.0) dwarfs every resolved sigma(0.1): proves FATTENS not caps (guards the cold-critic BLOCKER). n_eff=n_eff_res*(1-weight_on_thin) fattens tail. test_sigma_monotone confirms monotone in resolved sigma.

r4c-frozen-literal.title: ADJUDICATE _N_EFF_FLOOR frozen-literal
r4c-frozen-literal.imperative: Judge whether _N_EFF_FLOOR = NU_FLOOR - 2.0 is a DERIVED structural guard (APPROVE) or a minted/tuned frozen literal (BLOCK, floats to Admiral). State reasoning. Record pass/fail.
r4c-frozen-literal.finding: ADJUDICATION: DERIVED structural guard, NOT a minted/tuned frozen literal -> APPROVE. _N_EFF_FLOOR = NU_FLOOR - 2.0 is algebraically the finite-variance margin NU_FLOOR(=2.0+1e-6) already carries; no new magic number is typed (2.0 is Student-t's variance-finite threshold, a math fact). Purpose is structural: predictive_t rejects n_eff<=0, so this keeps n_eff strictly positive. It bites only in a near-degenerate resolved-weight~0 case (already caught by the fully-thin branch) and then yields the FATTEST (most conservative) tail, never tuning a prediction. It encodes no empirical/#675 value, so F12 pre-registration does not apply. Not an F12 concern; does not float to Admiral.
